verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no public API for programmatically driving Codex Plugins, such as installing, listing or invoking plugins. What it does show is adjacent: CLI slash commands and `codex plugin marketplace add`, a static public marketplace JSON file, and MCP as the protocol plugin authors use to expose their own tools. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so these CLI and developer building blocks earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use `codex plugin marketplace add` to add and track a marketplace source instead of editing `config.toml` by hand.
Plugins use the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)] to expose server-backed capabilities to ChatGPT and Codex.
